 PR Newswire Trinity Airways Unveils Double 11 Deals on Taiwan-Korea Routes
 PR Newswire   Nov. 12, 2026 09:00
 598 
 Enjoy Up to 15% Off and Exclusive Coupons for Travel through March 2027 
 SEOUL, South Korea and TAIPEI , Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trinity Airways, formerly known as T'way Air, is marking Taiwan's Double 11 shopping festival with special deals on its Taiwan–Korea routes. Customers can enjoy discounts of up to 15% with promo code NOV26 , along with additional savings through exclusive coupons. The offers are available for bookings made by November 30, 2026.
 Trinity Airways Unveils Double 11 Deals on Taiwan–Korea Routes 
 Trinity Airways currently operates seven routes between Taiwan and Korea. From Taipei, the airline flies from Songshan to Seoul (Gimpo) and from Taoyuan to Jeju and Daegu. From Kaohsiung, it serves Seoul (Gimpo and Incheon) and Jeju, while Taichung connects to Seoul (Incheon). Route map and flight schedules are available on the airline's website.
 The following offers are available for bookings made through November 30, 2026:
 Up to 15% off with Promo Code NOV26 : Enter NOV26 when booking eligible Taiwan–Korea flights for travel through March 27, 2027.
 TWD 1,111 Early Bird Coupon : Receive TWD 1,111 off bookings totaling TWD 8,000 or more on all Taiwan–Korea routes except Taipei (Songshan)–Seoul (Gimpo), for travel from February 1 through March 27, 2027. This is the largest coupon discount offered on Taiwan–Korea routes this year.
 Regular Coupons: Receive TWD 300 off bookings totaling TWD 6,000 or more on the Taipei (Songshan)–Seoul (Gimpo) route, or TWD 600 off bookings totaling TWD 6,000 or more on other Taiwan–Korea routes, for travel through March 27, 2027.
 Trinity Airways officially began operations under its new name on September 10, 2026, reflecting its new business strategy and commitment to delivering a more tailored travel experience.
 As part of this transformation, the airline is pursuing its Selective Service Carrier (SSC) model, adapting its offerings to different routes and customer preferences. Under this approach, Trinity Airways aims to maintain competitive fares on shorter routes while enhancing the experience on longer routes with premium check-in, airport lounges, and upgraded meals.
 "Trinity Airways is committed to providing greater value and a more comfortable journey for every customer," said Sang-yoon Lee, CEO of Trinity Airways. "Through our SSC model, we will continue to refine our services while prioritizing safe and reliable operations."
 For full flight schedules and booking details, visit trinityairways.com . Trinity Airways currently serves 60 destinations worldwide and continues to expand its network.
 About Trinity Airways (Formerly T'way Air) 
 Trinity Airways Co., Ltd. is a South Korean Selective Service Carrier (SSC) formerly known as T'way Air and began operating under the Trinity Airways brand on September 10, 2026. Under its SSC model, the airline provides services tailored to different routes and customer needs, combining air travel with the hospitality expertise and network of Sono Trinity Group to create a seamless travel experience. Based in Seoul, Trinity Airways serves destinations across Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. For more information, visit trinityairways.com .
